description: Startup bundle budget in bytes, checked by npm run check:bundle after npm run build. Set 2026-11-08 on AUREL main to measured sizes plus about 3% (entry JS 8,051,095 raw / 2,622,933 gzip; no static imports; entry CSS 594,839 raw / 94,102 gzip). Lower each limit when a work package shrinks the bundle; never raise one to land a change.
